arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib,hashlib
m=importlib.import_module('xmltodict')
actual=Path(m.__file__).resolve();expected=(Path.cwd()/'xmltodict.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
namespaces={'http://example.org/ns':'ns'}
values=(m._process_namespace('http://example.org/ns:item',namespaces),m._process_namespace('@http://example.org/ns:id',namespaces))
print('emission_names',values)
assert values==('ns:item','@ns:id')
import xmltodict
xml=xmltodict.unparse({'http://example.org/ns:root':{'@xmlns:ns':'http://example.org/ns','http://example.org/ns:item':'value'}},namespaces=namespaces)
print('emitted_xml',xml)
assert '<ns:root' in xml and '<ns:item>value</ns:item>' in xml
PYREPLAY
